desc: positive: Force sfb to dequeue from its child's gso_skb with qfq leaf
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.11.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 root handle 1: tbf rate 88bit burst 1661b peakrate 2257333 minburst 1024 limit 7b
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1: handle 2: sfb
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 2: handle 3: qfq
tc class add dev dummy1 classid 3:1 parent 3: qfq maxpkt 512 weight 1
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 3: protocol ip prio 1 matchall classid 3:1 action ok

readback.cmd: tc -s -j qdisc ls dev dummy1 parent 1:
readback.name: verify
